content:
name: PR Standard

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: pr-standard-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  runtime-http:
    name: Standard PR / Runtime HTTP
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: policy-engine
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Setup Policy Engine Python
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-policy-engine-python
        with:
          profile: runtime

      - name: Setup generated-client toolchain
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-runtime-dashboard

      - name: Verify runtime HTTP dependencies
        run: uv run python -c "import fastapi, jwt"

      - name: Run runtime HTTP suite
        run: |
          mkdir -p _build/.tmp/test-reports
          uv run pytest tests/unit/runtime/http -m "not quarantine" --durations=25 --junitxml=_build/.tmp/test-reports/runtime-http.xml

      - name: Upload runtime HTTP JUnit
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: junit-runtime-http
          path: policy-engine/_build/.tmp/test-reports/runtime-http.xml
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  frontend-quality:
    name: Standard PR / Frontend quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: policy-engine/apps/runtime-dashboard
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Setup Policy Engine Python
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-policy-engine-python
        with:
          profile: runtime

      - name: Setup runtime dashboard
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-runtime-dashboard
        with:
          install-playwright: "true"

      - name: Typecheck dashboard
        run: corepack pnpm run typecheck

      - name: Lint dashboard
        run: corepack pnpm run lint

      - name: Check formatting
        run: corepack pnpm run format:check

      - name: Check frontend architecture
        run: corepack pnpm run check:architecture

      - name: Run accessibility suite
        run: corepack pnpm run test:a11y

      - name: Upload accessibility artifacts
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: runtime-dashboard-a11y
          path: |
            policy-engine/_build/apps/runtime-dashboard/playwright-report
            policy-engine/_build/apps/runtime-dashboard/test-results
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  frontend-components:
    name: Standard PR / Frontend component smoke
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: policy-engine/apps/runtime-dashboard
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Setup runtime dashboard
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-runtime-dashboard
        with:
          install-playwright: "true"

      - name: Build Storybook
        run: corepack pnpm run build-storybook

      - name: Run Storybook interaction tests
        run: corepack pnpm run test:storybook

  frontend-contracts:
    name: Standard PR / Frontend contract drift
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: policy-engine
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Setup Policy Engine Python
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-policy-engine-python
        with:
          profile: runtime

      - name: Setup runtime dashboard
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-runtime-dashboard

      - name: Validate Playwright quarantine registry
        run: uv run python tools/quality/testing/check_playwright_quarantines.py

      - name: Verify Runtime API contract drift
        run: uv run --extra runtime --extra ml python tools/ops_runners/runtime/check_runtime_api_contract.py

      - name: Verify architecture and generated-client freshness
        run: uv run polisyos-tools architecture guardrails check

      - name: Verify runtime contract fixtures
        working-directory: policy-engine/apps/runtime-dashboard
        run: corepack pnpm run contracts:verify

      - name: Build dashboard
        working-directory: policy-engine/apps/runtime-dashboard
        env:
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN || '' }}
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
          VITE_SENTRY_RELEASE: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: corepack pnpm run build

      - name: Upload frontend build security artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: frontend-build-security
          path: policy-engine/_build/apps/runtime-dashboard/dist/security
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  frontend-smoke:
    name: Standard PR / Frontend smoke
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    needs:
      - runtime-http
      - frontend-contracts
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: policy-engine
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Setup Policy Engine Python
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-policy-engine-python
        with:
          profile: runtime

      - name: Setup runtime dashboard
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-runtime-dashboard
        with:
          install-playwright: "true"

      - name: Run Playwright smoke tests
        working-directory: policy-engine/apps/runtime-dashboard
        run: corepack pnpm run test:e2e:smoke

      - name: Upload smoke artifacts
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: runtime-dashboard-smoke
          path: |
            policy-engine/_build/apps/runtime-dashboard/playwright-report
            policy-engine/_build/apps/runtime-dashboard/test-results
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  performance:
    name: Standard PR / Performance
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: policy-engine
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Setup Policy Engine Python
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-policy-engine-python
        with:
          profile: runtime

      - name: Run performance suite
        run: |
          mkdir -p _build/.tmp/test-reports
          uv run pytest tests/performance -m "performance and not quarantine" --durations=25 --junitxml=_build/.tmp/test-reports/performance.xml

      - name: Upload performance JUnit
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: junit-performance
          path: policy-engine/_build/.tmp/test-reports/performance.xml
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  integration:
    name: Standard PR / Integration
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    needs:
      - runtime-http
      - frontend-smoke
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: policy-engine
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Setup Policy Engine Python
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-policy-engine-python
        with:
          profile: runtime

      - name: Run integration suite
        run: |
          mkdir -p _build/.tmp/test-reports
          uv run pytest -m "integration and not quarantine" --ignore=tests/unit/runtime/http --durations=25 --junitxml=_build/.tmp/test-reports/integration.xml

      - name: Upload integration JUnit
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: policy-engine/_build/.tmp/test-reports/integration.xml
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  test-economics:
    name: Standard PR / Test economics
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - runtime-http
      - performance
      - integration
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: policy-engine
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Setup Policy Engine Python
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-policy-engine-python
        with:
          profile: runtime

      - name: Download runtime HTTP JUnit
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: junit-runtime-http
          path: policy-engine/_build/.tmp/test-reports

      - name: Download performance JUnit
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: junit-performance
          path: policy-engine/_build/.tmp/test-reports

      - name: Download integration JUnit
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: junit-integration
          path: policy-engine/_build/.tmp/test-reports

      - name: Render economics summary
        run: |
          uv run python tools/quality/testing/report_test_economics.py \
            --report runtime-http=_build/.tmp/test-reports/runtime-http.xml \
            --report performance=_build/.tmp/test-reports/performance.xml \
            --report integration=_build/.tmp/test-reports/integration.xml \
            --allow-missing \
            --output _build/.tmp/test-reports/test-economics-summary.md
          cat _build/.tmp/test-reports/test-economics-summary.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Check directory health ratchet
        run: |
          uv run python tools/quality/validation/directory_health.py \
            --repo-root . \
            --json-output _build/.tmp/last-mile/directory-health.json \
            --markdown-output _build/.tmp/last-mile/directory-health.md \
            --fail-on-regression

      - name: Render test ratchet summary
        run: |
          uv run python tools/quality/testing/report_test_ratchets.py \
            --output _build/.tmp/test-reports/test-ratchets-summary.md \
            --fail-on-regression
          cat _build/.tmp/test-reports/test-ratchets-summary.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Upload economics summary
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: test-economics-summary
          path: |
            policy-engine/_build/.tmp/test-reports/test-economics-summary.md
            policy-engine/_build/.tmp/test-reports/test-ratchets-summary.md
            policy-engine/_build/.tmp/last-mile/directory-health.json
            policy-engine/_build/.tmp/last-mile/directory-health.md
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  frontend-unit-coverage:
    name: Standard PR / Frontend unit coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: policy-engine/apps/runtime-dashboard
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Setup Policy Engine Python
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-policy-engine-python
        with:
          profile: runtime

      - name: Setup runtime dashboard
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-runtime-dashboard
        with:
          # The suite this job exists to run includes Browser Mode tests, which
          # were unreachable while it sat behind three red predecessors. They
          # need Chromium.
          install-playwright: "true"

      # Deliberately has no `needs` on lint, formatting or architecture. Those
      # three are all red today, and while the suite sat behind them in one
      # sequential job it was never reached: a job that cannot get to its own
      # test step is evidence of nothing either way. A reached red suite is a
      # result; a skipped one is not.
      - name: Run coverage suite
        run: corepack pnpm run test:coverage

  standard-pr-gate:
    name: Standard PR / Gate
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - runtime-http
      - frontend-quality
      - frontend-unit-coverage
      - frontend-components
      - frontend-contracts
      - frontend-smoke
      - performance
      - integration
      - test-economics
    steps:
      - name: Enforce standard tier
        env:
          RESULTS: ${{ join(needs.*.result, ',') }}
          COVERAGE_RESULT: ${{ needs.frontend-unit-coverage.result }}
        run: |
          echo "Standard tier results: ${RESULTS}"
          if [[ "${RESULTS}" == *"failure"* || "${RESULTS}" == *"cancelled"* ]]; then
            echo "::error::Standard PR gate failed."
            exit 1
          fi
          # The aggregate above only rejects failure and cancelled, so a skipped
          # or missing coverage result would pass it silently. Name it.
          if [[ "${COVERAGE_RESULT}" != "success" ]]; then
            echo "::error::Frontend unit coverage did not complete successfully (${COVERAGE_RESULT})."
            exit 1
          fi
